paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Vun Natna Neih Nung A Kisiansakna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiai phak siansak ni a hihdan ding ahi. Siampu kiang a pi ding ahi.
english: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing. He shall be brought to the priest,

paite: Huchi in siampu giahphual pua ah apaikhe dia; siampu in a-en dia, ngai dih, phakmi pen aphakna hii adamleh
english: and the priest shall go forth out of the camp. The priest shall examine him, and behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

paite: siampu in akisiangsak ding mi vasa hing siang nih, sidar sing, khauzang san leh hissop tawisak ding in thu ape ding hi.
english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

paite: Siampu in vasa khat pen leibel ah luitui tung ah goh ding in thu ape ding hi.
english: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

paite: Vasa hing pen ala dia, sidar sing, khauzang san, hissop toh luitui luang tung a gohsa vasa sisan ah adiah vek ding hi.
english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

paite: Phakna a pan a kisiangsak ding mi sagihvei atheh dia, asiang chih apuang ding, huchi in vasa hing pen gamlak ah akhah ding hi.
english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

paite: Akisiangsak ding mi'n apuante asawp dia, akimetmai vek dia, akisil ding ahi. Huchi in ahong siang dia, huai khit chiang in giahphual ah ahoh dia, himahleh apuanin pua ah ni sagih a-om lai ding hi.
english: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ani sagih ni in alu a sam tengteng leh akhamul leh amitkhu multe ametmai dia, amul tengteng ametmai ding hi. Apuante asawp in akisil dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water, then he shall be clean.

paite: "Ani giat ni in belamnoupa nih gensiatbei leh belamnounu khat gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nel mahmah ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau a mek leh sathau thawl khat atawi ding ahi.
english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish, and three tenths of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

paite: Asiangsakpa siampu in kisiangsak ding mi leh huai thilte kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah akoih ding hi.
english: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in belamnoupa khat pen sathau log khat toh ala dia, tatlek thoihna ding in alan dia, TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding in avei ding hi.
english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Khelh thoihna leh halmang thillat agoh zelna mun uh, mun siangthou ah belamnoupa pen agou dia, khelh thoihna siampu a tuam ahih bang in tatlek thoihna leng siampu a tuam ahi; hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

paite: Siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan ala dia, kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam mongte, akhut taklam khutpite, ataklam khepite siampu in anuh ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

paite: Sathau log khat pen siampu in ala dia, amah khutpek veilam ah asung ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

paite: Siampu in akhut veilam a sathau ah akhut taklam zung adiah ding a, TOUPA ma ah akhutzung in sathau sagihvei atheh ding.
english: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Yahweh.

paite: Akhut a sathau om lai teng in kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi ah tatlekna kithoihna sisan tung ah anuh ding hi.
english: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

paite: Siampu in akhut a om lai teng in kisiangsak ding mi lu anuh dia; huchi in siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh.

paite: "Siampu in khelh thoihna alan dia, asianlouhna a pan kisiangsak ding mi pen kilemna abawlsak dia; huai khit in halmang thillat agou ding hi.
english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness: and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

paite: Siampu in halmang thillat leh tangbuang thillat maitam ah alat ding asiam a, siampu in kilemna abawlsak ding a, huchi in ahong siang ding hi.
english: and the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

paite: "Mizawng ahih a, hiaite aneih zoh keileh, belamnoupa khat tatlek thoihna, kilemna bawlsakna dia vei ding leh tangbuang thillat dia tangbuang nel mahmah ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau a zut, sathau log khat toh atawi ding ahi.
english: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

paite: Vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam, aneih zoh lamlam; khat khelh thoihna ding, khat pen halmang thillat ding ahi ding hi.
english: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

paite: Ani giat ni in akisiansakna ding in siampu kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah ahon tawi ding ahi.
english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belamnou leh sathau log khat ala dia, vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah siampu in avei ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Tatlek thoihna belamnou pen agou dia; siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan ala dia, kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh ding hi.
english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

paite: Siampu in sathau amah khutpek veilam ah asung ding ahi.
english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

paite: Siampu in akhut veilam a sathau khenkhat akhut taklam in TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in akhut a sathau in kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi leh tatlek kithoihna sisan tungtak ah anuh ding hi.
english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

paite: Siampu in akhut a sathau om lai teng in TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlsak ding in kisiangsak ding mi lu anuh ding hi.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Yahweh.

paite: Vakhu hiam, vapalnou hiam, aneih zoh lamlam khat alan dia;
english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to afford,

paite: aneih zoh lamlam, khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in khat, tangbuang thillat toh. Huchi in siampu in kisiangsak ding mi a ding in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding hi.
english: even such as he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

paite: Hiai bel phak hii vei, kisiansakna dan bang a chinloute a dia dan ahi,” achi hi.
english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
heading: Insung A Phak Hii
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Luah dia ka hon piak Kanaan gam na lut chiang ua, na luah ding uh gam a inn khat a phak hii ka koihleh,
english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

paite: Huai inn neitu in, hiai inn ah hii hileh kilawmtak omleh kilawm ka sa, chi in siampu ahong hilh ding ahi.
english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

paite: Siampu in hii a-en dia, alut ma in insung hihvuak ding in siampu in thu ape dia, hiai insung a thil om tengteng siang lou ahi ding hi; huai nung in siampu insung en ding in alut ding ahi.
english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

paite: Ama'n hii a-en dia, ngai dih, hii in ahinglam sim hiam asanlam sim hiam a baang anekkuak a, baang sang a niamzaw a akimuhleh,
english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall;

paite: siampu inn a pan kongpi ah apawt dia, ni sagih sung huai inn akhak ding ahi.
english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

paite: Ani sagih ni in siampu'n inn ava en nawn dia, ngai dih, hii pen huai inn baang a ana zamzakleh;
english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

paite: siampu in huai hii omna suang pen lakhia a, khopi polam a ninpaihna mun a paih ding in thu ape ding hi,
english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city:

paite: Insung lam akiatsiangsak kimvel dia, suang zutbitna a kiatkhiak leivui pen dainawl mun nin ah asung ding uhi.
english: and he shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scraped off, outside of the city into an unclean place.

paite: Suang dang ala ding ua, huai suangte mun ah akoih ding ua; suang zutbitna dang ala ding ua, inn ahu ding uhi.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

paite: "Suang alakkhiak a, inn akiat-siang a, ahuk khit nung a hii ahong dawk nawnleh, siampu ava lut dia, ava en nawn ding hi.
english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house, after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered;

paite: Ngai dih, hii ana zamzakleh huai inn a phak akipchi ahi a, siang lou ahi.
english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

paite: Huai inn aphel dia, asuang, asing leh asuang zutbitna teng leng dainawl mun nin ah anawnkhe vek ding ahi.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

paite: Kuapeuh huai inn khak ahih sung himhim alut taphot nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding hi.
english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh huai inn a lum taphot in apuante uh asawp ding ua; kuapeuh huai inn a an ne taphot in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi.
english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

paite: "Siampu alut a, a-et kimvel a, ngai dih, huai inn hukbit ahih nung a, hii azamzak keileh, inn asiang chih siampu in apuang ding; hii pen akikhinmang tak ziak in.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

paite: Inn siansakna ding in vasa nih leh sidar sing leh khauzang san leh hissop atawi ding hi.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

paite: Vasa khat pen leibel ah luitui luang tung ah agou ding hi.
english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

paite: Sidar sing, hissop, khau san leh vasa hing pen ala dia, vasa gohsa sisan ah leh luitui ah adiah ding hi.
english: He shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

paite: Vasa sisan, luitui luang, vasa hing pen, sidar sing, hissop leh khau san in huai inn asiangsak ding ahi.
english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

paite: Vasa hing pen khua a pan gamlak ah kilemna bawlna ding in alengkhesak dia; huchi in huai inn asiangsak ding a, ahong siang ding hi.
english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

paite: "Hiai pen phak hii chi chih leh meima sunglut tungthu a dan ahi;
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

paite: puan a-omleh innte a om phak a ding;
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

paite: chibawk, khem, pol leh chikang chihte toh kisai a,
english: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

paite: sianlouhna hun leh sianna hun a sinsak ding, phak dan ahi," achi hi.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.
